content.label: Every parent asks
content.question: Who will cook for you there?

answers.title: Learn basic cooking now
answers.detail: Dal, rice and one or two sabzis. Practise at home before you leave.

answers.title: A meal prep system
answers.detail: Cook a few things on the weekend and keep them ready. Weekdays get easier.

answers.title: Ask seniors
answers.detail: Seniors there know best where to buy Indian groceries.
